meaning: to worry too much about minor problems that are not important
example: My grandfather always tells me not to sweat the small things and to focus on what really matters.
synonyms: make a mountain out of a molehill

meaning: so hot that you feel very uncomfortable
example: In the sweltering heat of April, I try to stay indoors in the afternoons.

meaning: to be carried forward by a crowd or strong feeling without resisting
example: At the Pohela Boishakh procession, I was swept along by the music and colour of the crowd.

meaning: to stop thinking about work or problems and relax
example: Walking by the river after work helps me switch off and forget about deadlines.

meaning: representing an important idea or quality
example: Laying flowers at the memorial is a symbolic act of respect for those who died.

meaning: value that something has because of what it represents rather than its practical use
example: The Shaheed Minar has great symbolic importance for Bangladeshis because it honours the Language Movement.

meaning: a basic change to the way a whole system or organisation works
example: Reducing plastic waste requires systemic change, not only individual people recycling at home.

meaning: to make a determined effort to deal with dishonest behaviour by people in power
example: Digital payment systems can help tackle corruption by making every transaction easy to trace.
